Q: How to I see visual of my folder structure in RStudio? A:

Try the fs package. There you will find the function dir_tree(). That seems simplest to me.

Q: android 9PKQ1.180904.001 means which of android it is? A:

It is not a version but an ID. Basically, Android provides Build class in android.os package in which there are numbers of static properties and static classes provided related to OS info, there "ID" is the property you are looking for.

So, if you are a normal Android user, this does not need your concern.

Q: npm install gifsicle behind corporate proxy failed or stuck at windows system A:

I've faced similar issue not exactly same.npm install command for most of the packages. I am behind corporate proxy. For this i tried many solutions it never worked. Finally i did this,

Try to run the following command in cmd, npm config set https-proxy "http://your_companyproxy_here:8080"

Then it will work fine.

Q: Jenkins : Host key verification failed while executing ssh A:

It could be resolved if you add the server you're trying to connect to to the list of known hosts:

SERVER=jenkins@172.27.170.108              # Remote server
ssh-keyscan $SERVER >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts  # Add that server to the known_hosts list
ssh -T $SERVER                             # Connect

After success, the second line should be removed.

Explanation:

It fails for security reasons - on a connection attempt to an unknown server - it needs human supervision

Q: Adding highscores to java game - From console to JPanel - Saving highscore in encrypted text file A:

Basically you asked two questions and Leo answered your second question.

Your first question is...

what I need is that ...[the high scores]... gets outputted on a JPanel next to my maze

You didn't post any GUI code, but a subclass of JTextComponent would be more appropriate than a JPanel. Simply add a component, for example JTextArea and call its setText() method with your high score string as the method argument.

Q: How to use a subquery inside of FIND_IN_SET() in MySQL A: 
 SELECT `id_document` 
   FROM document d
   JOIN tags t
     ON FIND_IN_SET(t.id_tag,d.tags_document)
  WHERE t.tag_name = "example" ;

but please consider normalizing your data
